title: Concentration of the bootstrap empirical process, with applications to statistical inference
summary: Considering a general framework of bootstrap with exchangeable weights, we show some concentration inequalities for the supremum of the bootstrap empirical process. On the one hand, we discuss the concentration of the bootstrap empirical process around its conditional expectation with respect to the original data, and on the other hand, the concentration of the latter quantity around its mean.
